moment.title: Moment
moment.quote: MOMENT is a feature that indexes notes based on chronological order. It differs from Daily notes in that Daily notes indexes notes by days, while MOMENT refines the granularity of time indexing to every moment. Its value is obvious: (1) you can find all the notes you have created in chronological order; (2) you can get rid of the trouble of ""where to save the notes"" when taking notes, which is better than Daily Notes.
